mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates by reducing risk-free rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate above 5.0% signals weak consumer spending power and reduced corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 700,000 units indicate residential sector contraction, reducing household wealth and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST falls below 700.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 95.0 signals manufacturing sector weakness, reducing corporate profit margins and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 95.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in federal funds rate and unemployment rate signal coordinated monetary policy easing and labor market improvement, compressing equity risk premia and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and UNRATE both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS and UNRATE both decline, or interaction signal Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPI inflation and industrial production signal strong economic growth with rising inflation expectations, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL and INDPRO both increase from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL and INDPRO both increase, or interaction signal Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high consumer spending regimes (RSAFS > 400,000 million), rising housing starts above 750,000 units signal wealth effects boosting consumer confidence, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST rises above 750.0 and RSAFS exceeds 400,000, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing expansion regimes (INDPRO > 97.0), declining industrial production below 96.0 signals sector contraction, reducing earnings growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 96.0 and INDPRO exceeded 97.0 in prior month, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.
